crime: For weeks, {WITCH_NAME} composed a lullaby for a girl in the lounge, signing the original score. The girl rehearsed it there, singing it only for her. Before the other prisoners, however, {WITCH_NAME} scorned lullabies as childish.

Then one afternoon, the girl stood at the upper railing and used her phone to post a performance for all the prisoners, naming herself as the sole composer. In the courtyard, {WITCH_NAME} demanded credit. The girl tore up the signed score, scattered the scraps from the railing, and leaned out over it. {WITCH_NAME}'s shoulder-length hair lashed out, tightened into a noose beneath the girl's collar, and hauled her over the railing to her death. Once the girl had fallen, the hair withdrew to {WITCH_NAME}'s shoulders.

The prisoners found the girl's body in the courtyard amid the scraps and assumed she had lost her balance while scattering them. But when one prisoner unfastened her collar, a braided ligature furrow showed across her throat, with hair snagged in the clasp. The mark and trapped strand gave away the trick: the tether had been {WITCH_NAME}'s own hair, retracted out of sight after the pull.
fields.epitaph: In the end, she authored the one thing no one could dispute: silence.
execution: The execution stand locks her into a barber chair, a clamp pinning her chin. Steel shears open around her neck. Their blades snap shut and cross, severing her braids; her headless silhouette slumps into the chair.

magic.name: Hair Unbound
magic.text: She can lengthen, shorten, and move her own hair like prehensile limbs.
